skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Differentiate between conceptual content and know how to calculate macroeconomic statistical indices.
Identify appropriate statistical analysis methods for economic statistics research.
Use comprehensive statistical indices in economic and social management analysis.
Evaluate and explain statistical economic models and forecasts.
Have skills to collect, utilize data, choose and use tools in practical data collection, processing, analysis, and forecasting of economic statistical indices.
Compare and contrast the application of economic statistical indicators in real-world scenarios.
Select and use suitable statistical analysis methods for real-world situations.
Have opinions and awareness about the social context.
Have critical thinking in topic selection and problem solving in the field of population and labor.
